positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same underlying fact — Kestrelwood's calibration at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates — rendered first as prose (src-1) and then restated as structured field entries (src-2, src-3). The register pass groups all three under the same flat-technical-instrument signature (technical, matter-of-fact, no audience-directed performance), and affect/value reads are uniform calm-positive/competence across the set, supporting a single directional read.
